name: pkm
description: Personal knowledge management across two services: clip a finished AI session or a web page into a PARA Obsidian vault, resolve that vault git pull conflicts, write Obsidian notes, Bases, and Canvas files or drive the Obsidian CLI, and add or classify URLs in Karakeep.

interface.shortDescription: Obsidian vault clips and notes, Karakeep bookmark filing
interface.longDescription: PKM bundles the nine skills that keep a personal knowledge base current. obsidian-session-clip writes one markdown note per finished AI session into the vault Inbox and commits just that file. obsidian-web-clip saves one URL into the vault's 99-Inbox/Web in Obsidian Web Clipper format, without committing. obsidian-resolve-conflict diagnoses, classifies, resolves, commits, and pushes a vault git pull conflict without ever auto-merging a note body. karakeep-classify reads the live Karakeep List tree and proposes where a URL belongs, dry-run by default. karakeep-add performs the REST write, creating any missing List parents and deduplicating by URL. obsidian-markdown, obsidian-bases, and obsidian-canvas write Obsidian Flavored Markdown, .base, and .canvas files in the vault, and obsidian-cli drives a running Obsidian desktop app through the obsidian CLI; none of the four commits or contacts a remote. Both Karakeep skills need a reachable instance plus its API token; both Obsidian workflow skills need a local git-backed vault.
defaultPrompt: Clip this session to my vault.
Where should this bookmark go in Karakeep?
Make an Obsidian Base of my open tasks.
